A simple way to choose your starting point:

Want a coffee-style ritual with warming chai and cacao notes? Try our original MUD\WTR :rise.

turns.q: Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

riginal :rise: Our warming cacao-chai blend and classic coffee alternative.
Matcha: A matcha-based option for a bright, focused ritual.
Turmeric: A golden, spice-forward blend.
Rest: An evening-focused blend for winding down.
MUD\WTR Coffee: Our functional coffee option, for folks who want an actual coffee-style cup.
